column1: # Published prayer timetables for WorshipTimesTest (lane C, 2026-11-20). Every time below was copied from a page
# fetched on fetched_on from url (raw copies were checked value by value); none comes from Waaiya's own formula.
# Columns: lat/lon used for the comparison (coordinates says where they come from), tz, method = index into
# WorshipTimes.METHODS, asr_rule 0 = standard (no publisher states it; inferred), local clock times as published,
# utc_offset on that day as published tables show it (DST change days included: Cairo 04-24 and 10-30, Paris 03-29
# and 10-25, London 10-25, New York 03-08 and 11-01), source_kind official or calculator, checked = yes (asserted
# within 2 minutes) or no (recorded only; reason in notes).
# - Makkah: Umm al-Qura, official (KACST backend of ummulqura.org.sa). Ramadan 1448 starts 2027-02-08: Isha
#   Maghrib+120 from that day (+90 the day before).
# - Cairo: Egyptian General Survey Authority, official (esa.gov.eg monthly table; 12 h clock converted).
# - Istanbul: Diyanet, official. Fajr column is İmsak. Matches with temkin sunrise -7, dhuhr +5, asr +4,
# - Kuala Lumpur: JAKIM e-solat zone WLY01, official. Subuh is 18° since the MKI decision of 2019 (with 20°, the
#   old value, Fajr was 9-11 min early); ihtiyat +2.
# - Singapore: MUIS via data.gov.sg, official. Waaiya is about 1 min earlier on most times (within tolerance).
# - Jakarta: Kemenag data through the myQuran v3 mirror (bimasislam.kemenag.go.id did not answer from here); the
#   mirror says its source is Kemenag, last updated 2025-11-25, so the 2027 row's origin is unverified.
# - New York (ISNA 15/15), Paris (UOIF 12/12): calculators that state the method; no ISNA or UOIF timetable could
#   be fetched (403, script-only pages). They agree within 1 min.
# - London (MWL 18/17): calculator (truecalendar.com, "High-lat: NONE"). Not asserted: the page's dates are one
#   day off. Its row for each date equals Waaiya's times for the day before, to the minute, on all six times
#   (10-01, 10-24, 10-31; on 10-25 the same one-day shift shows as exactly 60 min because 10-24 was still summer
#   time), while against the same date it is 1-3 min off in opposite directions morning and evening. The saved
#   page itself carries these labels (raw copy checked). So MWL's angles match, but only through a mis-dated
#   calculator: no independent MWL timetable for London could be fetched (halaltrip.com: HTTP 403).
